= PlantUML Syntax Error

The block below is well formed as AsciiDoc; the third line of the diagram is not
PlantUML, so the renderer rejects it. That is the whole point of the fixture: without
rendering, asciidoctor only parses the block and the document validates clean.

The offending statement is the one the extract-diagrams fixture of the same name uses,
deliberately — two different bets on what PlantUML refuses would mean one suite silently
stops testing the failure path it was written for.

== Section

[plantuml,syntax-error,svg]
----
@startuml
Alice -> Bob : hello
!!! this line is not PlantUML at all (((
@enduml
----
